newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sintercast soars on first agreement.
newsitem.headline: Sintercast soars on first agreement.

text.p: Swedish development company Sintercast soared in early trade on Friday after announcing its first agreement to install its technology for casting car engine blocks.
By 0910 GMT the share had rocketed 74 crowns to 329 crowns.
The stock has recently taken a hammering after revelations that one of three Morgan Grenfell investment funds under investigation could hold up 57 percent of its shares.
"Despite everything that has been happening the company still has some value. People are probably focusing on that," one broker told Reuters after the share price hike.
Earlier on Friday the company announced an agreement with a North American foundry to install its technology for casting car engine blocks in a plant in Mexico.
Sintercast shares leapt to 550 crowns on the Swedish bourse this summer but was viewed as a highly speculative stock with no orders to date at that time.
